text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The new year has begun.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Tohhh!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*,
...Phew!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
All done, all done☆
Trainer, how was my time?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as she had promised,
Fusaichi Pandora worked truly hard.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm, uh-huh.
Looking super good♡"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Gonna take a lil' bweeak then~.
Tell me when it's time, 'kay~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She doesn't seem to do any solo training or anything beyond the planned routine, but—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Alright, going all out on the next one.
Make sure you time it perfectly, Trainer♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: I did it!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "She's started running with everything she has even without me prompting her, and—"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Huff, puff...!
No waaaay, 10 more kilometers to go...?!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ngh~~!!
For real? That's brutal~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No matter how grueling the training was,
somehow or another, she began to stick it out.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
“—Hey Trainer, this is crazy!
My friend just told me that the shrine's amazake this year is on another level!”

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: I wanna drink it♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She's as spoiled as ever, but even so, she truly is working hard.
choice_data_list: ...Pandora, you've really been working hard lately.
...Pandora, you've really been working hard lately.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ehe♡ Isn't it just?
Not only am I a genius, but a hard worker too♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Well, I wanna make my dreams come true too~ and look cool and sparkling like Kuu-chan-senpai~

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...And some amazake too? I kinda want some~?
choice_data_list: You're right, to make your dreams come true, from here on—
Yeah, from now on too, to make our dream come true—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
That may be true, but right now
I really want some sweet amazake♪
choice_data_list: And with that, the next training is...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Hey, sweet sake!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...As a reward for working hard,
we decided to go to the shrine after training
to buy some amazake.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Mmmmmm♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
That was totally on a whole other level, like, for real♡
Sooo awesome, so lucky-happy♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I mean, we came all the way out here,
so let's hang out a bit more before heading home~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As for what I could do here...
choice_data_list: Pay our respects at the shrine.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
A charm?
Sounds great, let's buy one, buy one☆

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
This year, it's gotta be a victory charm.
Plus safety for the family, and...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Trainer, what're you gonna dooo?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that reminds me.
I'll pick one out for you.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
A victory charm, and prayer for good health of course!
Then, traffic safety, and success in work, and...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ………………Wait, you want success in love?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh? Which is it? Are they there!?
No way, we totally don't need them, right?"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
......What?!
You have a crush on someone?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...At any rate, I was able to spend
a wonderful New Year's
together with Fusaichi Pandora.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—After returning home. Browsing social media to gather info,
I noticed a familiar name featured as a 'Notable Umamusume.'

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Sounds nice♡
I've been smelling something sweet for a while now.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, what should I do!
There's cotton candy, candy apples,
chocolate carrots, soft-serve ice cream...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ah, that reminds me!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: No, all of it♡
choice_data_list: No, you'll get an upset stomach!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh~~, I won't break it!
Don't underestimate Umamusume, I won't break it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, she ended up buying and eating as many sweets as she liked.
True enough, she didn't get a stomachache, but—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I don't wanna eat sweets anymore.
You can have this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...At any rate, I was able to spend
a wonderful New Year's
together with Fusaichi Pandora.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—After returning home. Browsing social media to gather info,
I noticed a familiar name featured as a 'Notable Umamusume.'

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Aha☆ I totally forgot~.
Oh yeah, we gotta get on that!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rattle, rattle... Clack-clack!)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...A-And...
...and also...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Was my wish long? Felt pretty normal to me.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Not really... Just wished to win the Triple Tiara, and stuff.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: I wished for Papa, Mama, my big brothers and sisters, and Trainer to all stay healthy, and—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"I wanna stop putting on Heart-chan's uniform when I'm half-asleep in the morning,
and like, I really hope we don't get much homework."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: I want more yummy cafes by the station~, and I wanna check out high-end department store cosmetics~, and I hope I don't get a sunburn~—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: About this much?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
âAh, wait!
I just remembered what I forgot to wish for!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Please, God, let me win the lottery for the limited-edition lipstick!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...At any rate, I was able to spend
a wonderful New Year's
together with Fusaichi Pandora.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—After returning home. Browsing social media to gather info,
I noticed a familiar name featured as a 'Notable Umamusume.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Kawakami Princess.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She was an Umamusume I had occasionally seen on the grounds,
and a close friend of Fusaichi Pandora."

text_block_list.name: Social Media Comment
text_block_list.text:
"I caught a glimpse of her training on video, and she definitely has talent."
"She's got unbelievable grit. That alone makes her likeable."

text_block_list.name: Social Media Comment
text_block_list.text:
"She's aiming for the Tiara route, right?"
"She hasn't debuted yet, huh? I hope she does her best."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't quite a full-blown uproar,
but it seemed to be steadily drawing attention.
choice_data_list: (She hasn't even debuted yet, but she's incredible.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Feeling the presence of formidable rivals...
The decisive year on the Tiara route has begun!
